do_not_use_as_outcome: a quality band or low-value finding (quality, not recovery)
the first outpatient visit after discharge when it is a different problem
silence or no follow-up on its own (never positive)
definition.negative: pus or surgical-site infection (not expected serous drainage), fever, spreading redness, an unplanned return to theatre or revision, or a same-problem outpatient visit that documents a complication; planned staging is not negative
definition.positive: an indicated operation, no negative finding, and after the procedure window either (1) post-discharge care-manager questions exist and are clean and any same-problem outpatient visit in the window documents no harm, or (2) a same-problem visit in the window with no complaint or symptomatically better; expected symptoms do not veto
definition.neutral_protocol: still on a planned dirty-case wound pathway (negative-pressure dressing, empiric intravenous antibiotics, dressings) without meeting negative; not recovered, do not promote
definition.unscored: empty post-discharge questions or a missed call with no later clean same-problem note; the only note is before the window; a later visit is a different problem and no same-problem follow-up exists

windows_last_same_problem_note_inside.stones: post-procedure; a planned stent removal is allowed

read_order: last same-problem outpatient note inside the window
definition.escalate: ask a medical reader when wound versus expected drainage, or staging versus a return to theatre, is the fork
definition.engine_note: engine llm_zdr, draft. 0.2.0: reader stay_record (stay key; theatre note, discharge, cdmss extract, outpatient records inside the window by the patient bridge). The model proposes; CODE decides: window class from the procedure keyword table, silence or no same-problem record is never positive, a negative code is negative unless planned staging is stated. Care-manager post-discharge questions are not read (cm_questions: not_read), so positive needs a same-problem record in the window with no complaint or better. Definition text above is unchanged from 0.1.0. 0.2.1 (PHI): evidence stores no note text: the model's quote is located in the source and only {item (closed enum), source, record_ref, offsets} are kept. 0.2.2 (PHI): record_ref is a salted hash of the row uid, never the uid.
